cohort: The study participants included 44 pregnant women over 34 weeks gestation undergoing cesarean section due to non-acute fetal distress and 61 healthy pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section, from whom umbilical cord blood was collected.
finding: The study found that native thiol and total thiol levels were significantly lower, and ischemia-modified albumin (IMA) levels were significantly higher, in the fetal distress group compared to healthy pregnant women.
cross-section timing: Umbilical cord blood was collected at the time of cesarean section.
